Distance between two points in \(\mathbb{R}^3\)

Let \(A={@A@}\) and \(B={@B@}\). Compute the distance \(\,|AB|\).

\[ |AB|=\sqrt{(x_B-x_A)^2+(y_B-y_A)^2+(z_B-z_A)^2}. \]
